housing_w.note: Placeholder envelope widened to contain the 112 mm roller, projecting spindle pins and 8 mm bearing supports; not a measured product dimension.

housing_d.note: Placeholder body depth only; no calibrated retail measurement.

lower_shell_h.note: Schematic lower shell height; not a patent or retail measurement.

upper_shell_h.note: Schematic upper shell height; not a patent or retail measurement.

reservoir_w.note: Placeholder internal envelope; reservoir dimensions and capacity are unknown.

reservoir_d.note: Placeholder internal envelope; reservoir dimensions and capacity are unknown.

reservoir_h.note: Placeholder internal envelope; reservoir dimensions and capacity are unknown.

roller_d.note: Chosen 12 mm radius is within the patent description's example 10–30 mm radius range; not a measured production dimension.

roller_len.note: Provisional axial length selected to span the current eight-tooth layout (110 mm overall envelope). No patent length or retail measurement has been established.

tooth_count.note: Eight teeth in the described illustrated patent embodiment; not proof of retail SKU count.

tooth_width.note: Approximate 0.5 cm width in the described embodiment; not verified on retail sample.

tooth_length.note: Approximate 10 mm derived from the patent statement that blade length is around twice its approximate 5 mm width; not a separately dimensioned or measured retail value.

tooth_height.note: Schematic radial projection length used for the research model.

tooth_pitch.note: Provisional 15 mm centre pitch interpreted as 5 mm tooth width plus 10 mm clear gap. Patent wording on adjacent-tooth spacing is ambiguous; do not treat this as a fixed constraint.

wall_thickness.note: Placeholder shell thickness needed to make a solid curved carrier; patent drawing does not dimension it.

roller_seat_clearance.note: Radial clearance proxy between roller surface and concave wall seat; no tolerance or fit specification is disclosed.

wall_segment_angle_deg.note: Figure 6B shows an approximately 180-degree semi-cylindrical wall embodiment. The disclosure also describes angles greater than 90 degrees; 180 degrees is a selected illustrated embodiment, not a measured retail angle.

wall_len.note: Set equal to provisional roller length to create a continuous longitudinal seat; no authoritative length is disclosed.

slot_w.note: Placeholder axial slot width. Patent describes arcuate through-slots but does not dimension their width.

exploded_gap.note: Presentation-only exploded-view spacing; not product geometry.

roller_core_d.note: Provisional smooth roller core diameter beneath raised textured bands; inferred layout proxy, not dimensioned by patent.

roller_band_count.note: One raised circumferential band aligned to each of the seven modelled wall slots; count is an engineering interpretation, not a dimensioned patent count.

roller_band_width.note: Placeholder axial width for each textured roller band; not disclosed as a dimension.

roller_band_raise.note: Radial projection of textured band above smooth core; placeholder only.

roller_endwall_d.note: Placeholder diameter for roller end walls; patent shows end walls but supplies no dimensions.

roller_endwall_t.note: Placeholder axial thickness for each roller end wall.

spindle_pin_d.note: Placeholder spindle-pin diameter; patent drawings show pins without a dimension.

spindle_pin_len.note: Placeholder spindle-pin projection beyond each end wall.

bearing_block_w.note: Placeholder axial width of each housing bearing support.

bearing_block_d.note: Placeholder depth of each bearing support block.

bearing_block_h.note: Placeholder height of each bearing support block.

bearing_bore_clearance.note: Radial clearance proxy between spindle pin and bearing bore; not a production tolerance.

snap_tab_w.note: Placeholder width of a housing snap-fit tab.

snap_tab_d.note: Placeholder depth of a housing snap-fit tab.

snap_tab_h.note: Placeholder height of a housing snap-fit tab.

snap_tab_count.note: Two visible snap-tab proxies, one near each longitudinal end; actual latch count/layout unverified.

provenance_legend.PATENT_DISCLOSED: Explicitly disclosed in patent text or illustrated embodiment; not automatically a retail measurement.
provenance_legend.PATENT_DERIVED_ESTIMATE: Selected or calculated within a patent-disclosed range; exact value is not disclosed.
provenance_legend.MEASURED: Measured from an authorised physical sample with method and uncertainty recorded.
provenance_legend.IMAGE_ESTIMATED: Estimated from imagery with scale/calibration and confidence recorded.
provenance_legend.ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: Chosen for a schematic model; not asserted as product truth.
provenance_legend.SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED: Supported by authorised tooling or manufacturing documentation.
